Hi Samir & Lydia —

Thanks again for the demo last week. As discussed, I’m kicking off the mutual action plan (MAP) and evaluation playbook so we have clarity on success criteria, owners, and milestone timing for the POC. I’ve attached a first draft of the MAP and a short benchmark spec.

High-level proposal (please review):
- Timeline: 6-week POC window, target decision by Oct 27, 2026.
- Success criteria (pass/fail buckets):
  • Latency: median inference latency < 250ms on your test harness (95th pct target < 450ms)
  • Quality: top-line generation acceptability >= 85% on the labeled prompt set (we’ll co-develop prompts)
  • Cost: projected per-1000-token cost <= your target budget (we’ll model with Redwood Optimize)
- Benchmark plan: three prompt buckets (instructional prompts, conversational threads, long-context retrieval prompts). Full spec in benchmark_spec.xlsx.
- Owners (Redwood): Marcus (commercial lead), Marissa (evaluation & prompts), Stephanie (CS/support).
- Greenwell owners requested: product lead (prompt/ground-truth), engineering (integration), procurement.

Asks for your team: please confirm named owners for the roles above, any hard constraints on timeline, and whether SOC2/TLS artifacts need to be provisioned before we start. We can shift the kickoff one week if procurement requires extra lead time.

Next steps: once we have owners, Marcus and I will finalize the MAP doc and propose a calendar for the kickoff workshop (ideally next week).

Thanks — looking forward to partnering on this.

Best,
Neha Kapoor

Hi all — thanks for the roadmap. Confirming Greenwell owners and a couple additions to success criteria:

- Owners confirmed: Lydia Park (product lead – prompts & labeled set), Rajesh Kumar (eng lead — integration), Procurement (procurement@greenwell.ai).
- Additional success items:
  • End-to-end inference latency under expected peak load: p50 < 250ms, p95 < 600ms (we may accept a slightly higher p95 under sustained bursts)
  • Response stability: no more than 2% generation variance vs. baseline on the holdout set
  • Safety: zero high-severity hallucinations on the 200-sample safety checklist (we’ll provide checklist)
